response.sql:
WITH signal_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    COUNT(*) as signal_count,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as total_signals
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
)
SELECT 
  telescref,
  signal_count,
  signal_count || '/' || total_signals as fraction,
  total_signals
FROM signal_counts
WHERE total_signals IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CAST(signal_count AS REAL) / total_signals DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "unrounded fraction" means displaying the result as a text string in format "numerator/denominator" (e.g., "45/100") rather than a decimal number
"the total" refers to the grand total count of all signals across all telescope groups (used as the denominator of each fraction)
No filtering applied to signals; all records in the signals table are included in the counts
